cheatNotes: _` Fight Son Gokuu
- Get 3 Special Stages finishes
_` Special Stage Finishes
_` Genesis (A group of meteors plummet from the sky)
- Perform your Taunt, Taunt 2, Time Over Pose, and Fake Dizzy all in one round
- Then win that round
_` Jurassic Period (A prehistoric fish jumps out of the water)
- Finish your opponent with a Super Desperation
_` The Ice Age (A snowman forms in the background)
- Throw your opponent three times in a single round
- Then win that round
_` The Stone Age (A huge piece of dino meat falls from the sky)
- Move your character so that their sprite passes by each of the following items in order:
- The flame to the immediate left of the screen
- The animal fur in the far right corner
- The stone axe located near the flame
- The red potatoes on the floor to the immediate right of the screen
_` The Megalithic Age (A sparrow flies across the screen)
- Win the round with your Hero Gauge at MAX
_` The Dark Age (Bats fly from the top of the screen)
- Move your character to either corner of the stage
- Then make your way to the opposite corner in under 10 seconds
- Then win that round
_` Genroku Period (A chicken falls from the sky)
- Perform a combo of 5 hits
- Then win that round
_` The Industrial Revolution (Steam comes out of the train's side whistle)
- Land a Desperation move before the timer reaches 70
- Then win that round
_` Great War Period (Brocken flies across the screen in the background)
- Your lifebar as well as your opponent's lifebar must be below ½
- Land 3 successful Blow Defenses
- Then win that round
_` The Period (A dog statue drops from the sky)
- Win a round with a Perfect
- Only on a 1P Game
